system.description:
Kishai Inheritance: a traded good. Legendary[1], Rot. 1 item slot. Attunement. Special Property: Spores.

Prerequisites: Wiles[4]

A small metal contraption, filled with gears and mechanisms. It looks like it can be turned along one axis, opening small openings all over the sides. It’s letting out such a pretty light!

Grappleshot (Action): Make an attack using Finesse against a target ‘s TD within 40ft. If you hit, they take 3D10+Finesse damage and they make a Power Check against your Check DC against the Dragged condition. For as long as they have the rope embedded in them, they cannot fly (if they have wings). As a reaction, you may release the rope. The target can only end the Dragged Condition when they remove the rope (which requires a Power check against your Check DC using the Make Trait Check action).

Load Grappling Hook (Action): You load the grappling hook with a shot.

Hook Ledge (Action): You fire a shot up to 40ft, locking the rope into a spot within range. This creates a taught rope that can be climbed or balanced across using Acrobatics.

Rulebook p.76.
